name: Disk diagnose
rationale: Workflow pack: read-only disk/memory probes suitable for promotion to a trusted routine.

args.command: Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Select-Object Name, Used, Free | Format-Table | Out-String

steps.summary: Read-only: report free disk space per drive
